title: Share Buttons
description: Share buttons that copy the link to items as an icon badge. For tasks, this would be near the edit icon, and in a similar position for other things like pages and memories. Memories have a copy content button, which would also be useful to add to pages and tasks.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Completed by adding header-bar share buttons for `/tasks` and `/pages`. `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/Tasks.razor` now supports `?task=` deep links plus clipboard copy from the selected-task header, and `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/Pages.razor` now exposes the same clipboard share affordance in both the selected-page and edit headers. Focused guard coverage passed via `dotnet test .\MemorySmith.Tests\MemorySmith.Tests.csproj -c Release --filter "Name~TasksMarkup_PrioritizesSelectedTaskSummaryAndFocusAction|Name~TasksMarkup_UnifiesArtifactsAndShareableDeepLinks|Name~PagesMarkup_RebalancesNavigationAndReadingSpaceOnNarrowViewports|Name~PagesMarkup_UsesHeaderShareActionsForSelectedPages|Name~ChatMarkup_UsesAdminDefinedModelProfilesForSelection|Name~ChatMarkup_ReconcilesApproveAllBatchOutcomesAndPendingState|Name~ChatMarkup_DefaultsSidebarClosedUntilHistoryOrTraceIsRequested|Name~ChatMarkup_SupportsQuestionCardsWithOtherResponses" --logger "console;verbosity=minimal"`, which passed 8/8 after the share-link changes.
